$comment: The footprintjs family, one list. scripts/audit-consumers.mjs audits every entry with `checks` against each footprintjs release candidate (docs/guides/consumer-audit.md). scripts/audit-family-versions.mjs reads every entry: `published` ones are the family packages whose versions it compares; the rest are apps it checks for drift. `dir` is the checkout's directory name under the org root, and in the audit's workspace.

family.note: C5 train, temporary: the branch writes through footprintjs/write, which no published footprintjs hands out, so its `prepare` build fails against its lockfile's footprintjs. It installs without scripts and builds against the candidate as its first check. It cannot build on the published footprintjs either, so it has no fallback leg: any red step blocks. Branch, install, checks and fallback return to main and the defaults once footprintjs 9.47.0 and hcifootprint 2.7.0 are out.

C5 train, temporary: the branch takes CommitBundle and applySmartMerge from footprintjs/trace, which no published footprintjs hands out, so it has no fallback leg: any red step blocks. Branch and fallback return to main and the default once footprintjs 9.47.0 and its release are out.

C5 train, temporary: the Lens's tests load agentfootprint, and the release it pins imports a name footprintjs 9.47.0 takes off /advanced (applySmartMerge), so it cannot load on this candidate. The Lens runs on agentfootprint's migration branch instead: a sibling built after the candidate is swapped in, then linked in place of the installed agentfootprint, sharing the Lens's footprintjs (one module instance). That sibling cannot build on the published footprintjs, so there is no fallback leg: any red step blocks. Returns to the defaults once that agentfootprint release is out and the Lens pins it.

ui/ links ../../storydeck, so storydeck is a sibling checkout with its own dependencies. The browser tests launch Playwright's headless shell, so setup fetches it. The demo-agent tests read the built ui stylesheet, so build:ui runs first.

Links footprintjs and footprint-explainable-ui by file: path; the published explainable-ui replaces its link, as the playground's own deploy workflow does. src/samples/examples links ../../../footPrint/examples, which the workspace provides. --ignore-scripts: npm would run the linked footPrint checkout's own prepare (husky), a footprintjs dev hook; the playground has no install script of its own.

Bundles ../agentfootprint/examples (the @samples alias) and links ../agentfootprint, so agentfootprint is a built sibling checkout; the lens and explainable-ui come from npm. agent-samples is linked but never imported. --ignore-scripts: as for footprint-playground, it links ../footPrint. C5 train, temporary: the sibling is agentfootprint's migration branch, which builds only against this candidate (it takes CommitBundle and applySmartMerge from footprintjs/trace), so it is built as the first check, after the candidate is swapped in, not in its setup. Its own build and tests are red on main too (an own failure), so it keeps the fallback leg; the sibling build is the step this train adds. Branch, setup and checks return to main and the defaults once footprintjs 9.47.0 and the agentfootprint release are out.
